text: Your dog will never tell you who she is. Your cat won't either.
So cocoverse builds your pet's AI twin the only honest way: from what they actually do. Every photo becomes a card, a Memory Print. The twin grows only from those cards, and never makes up a memory.
Three layers. General knowledge about the breed and the place, always labelled. Her own moments, read from each photo. And your words, which outrank anything the AI guessed.
This is Coco's cocoverse. Each day, she asks her owner for one more moment from their life together.
Her owner shares a photo. Muse Spark reads it, and says what Coco learned.
Then the owner adds the story no photo can show. Those words outrank anything the AI guessed.
Each memory earns points, and points open a pack. Muse Image has already painted the memories in the background, each in a style you don't know until the card turns over.
On rare cards, SAM 3.1 cuts Coco out of the painting, so she moves in front of the scene.
Cards fill series that follow who Coco is: her favourite things, her friends, her places, the seasons of a year.
Now ask her something. Coco answers in her own voice, and names the cards her answer comes from.
Ask about something she has never been shown, and she says so, instead of making it up.
Her picture of herself starts as a blur. With every moment and every word from you, it sharpens, and she learns new moves.
Everything she knows is a small graph: how she is, her things, her people, her places. Every link rests on real cards, and general knowledge stays outside.
Coco also knows where she lives: the local rules, each with its source and when it was checked.
So when you ask her along to the store, she checks the weather and the rules first, before she says yes. And under every answer she shows what she did.
Before Coco meets a new friend, their twins meet first. Each one speaks only from its own photos, and both owners get one honest note.
It works on your phone, in your language, and a sitter can talk to Coco's twin through a link.
Under the hood, four Meta models, and one rule in code: only what really happened counts.
cocoverse. A little universe for you and your pet.
